Paragraph.Text: Tauri is designed with a "security-first" mindset. Because the backend has full OS access, Tauri implements a strict permission system to prevent the frontend from doing things it shouldn't.

The frontend (WebView) is sandboxed. It cannot access the filesystem or network directly using native Rust APIs; it can only do so by calling Tauri commands that you have explicitly written and exposed.
